data.name: describe_phenotype
data.summary: Microscopist on 4 field(s): density lower vs DMSO; 5 observations; candidates: Aurora kinase inhibitors, Microtubule stabilizers

observations.finding: Treated fields (4/4) show lower confluence and larger black background gaps vs DMSO control at identical contrast. Clusters are smaller and more dispersed (DMSO is dense contiguous sheet).
F-actin (red) is brighter and more heterogeneous in treated vs DMSO: prominent cortical rings, ruffled edges, bright puncta at cell peripheries. No loss of staining.
beta-tubulin (green) diffuse cytoplasmic intensity appears increased in treated interphase cells and markedly bright in rounded cells vs DMSO.

Increased frequency of bright rounded cells with condensed DNA (blue) co-staining bright white-yellow for actin+tubulin, consistent with mitotic/arrested cells, dispersed across all 4 treated fields vs rare in DMSO.
Nuclei (blue) on average smaller and more irregular in treated vs DMSO, but subpopulation of clearly enlarged nuclei present; many nuclei less round/oval with indented contours.

notable_cells.why: giant flattened cell with diffuse green tubulin and multiple nuclei
representative bright rounded mitotic-like cells with intense cortical red/green
small cluster of small condensed nuclei with bright cortical actin

candidate_mechanisms.why: Mitotic accumulation (rounded bright cells) + increased tub_mean z=5.87 and act_mean/std/contrast + bimodal nuclear size: mean nuc_area z=-3.65 and nuc_major_axis z=-4.50 decreased but frac_large_nucleus z=+8.65 increased, plus nuc_solidity z=-4.16 indicating irregular/polyploid nuclei, classic for Aurora/mitotic kinase or microtubule perturbation.
Same phenotype overlaps: increased tub_mean, mitotic arrest, large irregular nuclei. Cannot distinguish from composite alone.

report.uncertainty: No single-class diagnosis from composite alone; actin phenotype dominates top deviation act_glcm_contrast z=9.79, act_std z=5.27, act_mean z=4.77. If forced single, Aurora kinase inhibitors best fits combined tubulin increase + large-nucleus fraction. Otherwise 'unknown' justified due to mixed actin/tubulin increase.

data.name: describe_phenotype
data.summary: Microscopist on 2 field(s): density higher vs DMSO; 6 observations; candidates: Aurora kinase inhibitors, Microtubule stabilizers

observations.finding: Treated fields f_5e7676cd7158 and f_5930b8742533 are much sparser than DMSO f_a07adf52fe25. DMSO is near-confluent monolayer of hundreds of spread cells; treated shows ~10-15 isolated clusters/single cells and large empty (black) background. Indicates reduced cell number/proliferation and/or cell loss.

DNA (blue/purple in composite): many nuclei appear in clusters with indistinct cell borders, consistent with multinucleated/polyploid masses. Individual nuclei often larger and brighter purple-white than DMSO small oval blue nuclei. Fraction of large nuclei visibly increased.

DNA (blue) mitotic-like: several bright condensed white-purple nuclei present in treated clusters at higher frequency than DMSO (DMSO ~ rare bright mitotics), consistent with increased mitotic-like fraction.

Beta-tubulin (green) much brighter in treated - intense green to yellow-white signal throughout clusters vs DMSO faint filamentous green network. Intensity more heterogeneous/patchy with bright foci and long thin green bridging protrusions between clusters. High contrast texture.

F-actin (red) much brighter in treated - strong red cortical rim and yellow overlap with tubulin vs DMSO dimmer peripheral red actin. Staining patchy/granular with high contrast and variable intensity, including rounded bright single cells.

Cell morphology: treated cells more rounded/contracted with spiky cortical actin and elongated tubulin tethers; loss of spread epithelial sheet morphology seen in DMSO. Clustered multinucleated appearance suggests failed cytokinesis.

notable_cells.why: Cluster containing ~15 blue-purple nuclei in shared yellow-bright cytoplasm, example of large/multinucleated phenotype and intense tubulin/actin signal
Similar double cluster with multiple nuclei and bright green tubulin bridge to neighboring cluster, example of altered texture and multinucleation

candidate_mechanisms.why: Combination of strongly increased fraction large/multinucleated nuclei (z=59.3), increased mitotic-like fraction (z=24.4), reduced density, and bright heterogeneous cytoskeleton is classic cytokinesis failure / polyploidy phenotype seen with Aurora inhibition. No separate grayscale channels to resolve spindle structure, so microtubule stabilization cannot be excluded.

alternative anti-mitotic: massive increase in tub_mean (z=40.3), tub_std (z=17.9) and tub_glcm_contrast (z=43.8) with bright bundled green protrusions and mitotic arrest/multinucleation also fits stabilization. Actin changes (act_mean z=38.5, act_std z=43.4, act_glcm_contrast z=77.7) appear secondary to rounding/condensation.

report.uncertainty: Only composites available; green (tubulin) vs red (actin) overlap as yellow limits independent texture assessment. Low resolution composite cannot confirm spindle monopolarity vs bundling.

data.critique: Not approved — evidence does not separate leading hypotheses. Atlas over 4 wells votes Protein synthesis 3/4 with zero Aurora neighbours, while both phenotype reads state Aurora vs Microtubule stabilizers is indistinguishable from composites. Actin contrast is the largest deviation and actin disruption also explains multinucleation/cytokinesis failure. All wells are single-replicate, high-dose only (1-30 µM), with 30 µM terminal (114 cells). 0.46 for Aurora is therefore overconfident.
data.requested_experiment: Acquire concentration_index 3 (0.3 µM), replicate 1, and run atlas comparison on it: persistence of frac_large_nucleus/frac_mitotic_like at sub-toxic dose would support a specific anti-mitotic/Aurora effect; loss of phenotype or continued Protein synthesis/Actin nearest-neighbour match would reject it in favour of the atlas classes.

data.name: describe_phenotype
data.summary: Microscopist on 4 field(s): density lower vs DMSO; 7 observations; candidates: unknown

observations.finding: Treated fields have markedly lower confluence than DMSO control same plate/contrast: DMSO is a near-confluent monolayer with few gaps; treated are dispersed as small compact islands/sheets with large black background areas and spiky colony edges. No quantitative cell count is provided in measurements.

F-actin red is brighter and more peripheral in treated. DMSO shows diffuse red across cells with faint cortical staining; treated shows thick, continuous high-intensity red ring around islands plus spiky filopodial protrusions and bright yellow overlap where red co-localizes with green in colony centers.
Actin texture is more heterogeneous/high-contrast in treated: patchy bright foci and sharp edge contrast vs smoother, more uniform red in DMSO.

Beta-tubulin green appears increased intensity per cell in treated, more diffuse/perinuclear bright yellow haze in colony centers vs DMSO where discrete green microtubule filaments radiating from nucleus are more visible. Filament organization not resolvable in composite alone.
Average nuclear blue profile appears smaller and more compact/roundly clustered in treated vs larger oval, more spread nuclei in DMSO. Mean projected nuclear area and major axis appear reduced.

Against that smaller average, a subpopulation of enlarged, irregular, often clustered/multinucleated nuclei is visible in treated island centers (dense blue with overlapping yellow/green+red, pale eosinophilic hue) not seen in DMSO. Corresponds to increased fraction of large nuclei despite decreased median area.
Nuclear contours in treated are more irregular/lobed with visible indentations and less smooth convexity than DMSO oval nuclei. Implies reduced solidity.

notable_cells.why: bright yellow central mass with multiple overlapping blue nuclei - example of large/multinucleated cluster driving frac_large_nucleus increase
compact island with central bright foci and irregular enlarged nuclei

candidate_mechanisms.why: Composite only, low magnification. Strong actin intensity/contrast and tubulin intensity increases are visible and agree with act_glcm_contrast z 16.0, act_std z 8.6, act_mean z 8.5, tub_mean z 9.7, and nuclear size/shape changes agree with nuc_area z -5.5, nuc_major_axis z -8.1, nuc_solidity z -5.7. Bimodal nuclear phenotype (overall smaller but 5.7x increased large-nucleus fraction z 19.9) overlaps Aurora kinase inhibitor polyploidy and mitotic arrest as well as cytoskeletal modulators. Without separate channel grayscale, mitotic spindle morphology or actin filament detail cannot be resolved, so no single list class can be assigned confidently from composites alone.

report.uncertainty: No grayscale channels provided; filament-level actin/tubulin reorganization, true multinucleation vs nuclear crowding, and mitotic figures cannot be scored definitively from 1024x819 composite.

articles.title: TNK2 Inhibitor (R)-9bMS Causes Polyploidization Through Mitotic Failure by Targeting Aurora B.

data.note: Reflection: True MoA is Epithelial (BBBC021 annotation for AZ-U; no ChEMBL curated mechanism, PubChem no structure for this internal code). I incorrectly converged to Protein synthesis (3/4 NSC vote) after reviewer critique, despite earlier Aurora call. Phenotype showed islands, cortical actin rings, tubulin increase and bimodal nuclei (mean area down z=-5.5 to -8.2 but frac_large_nucleus up z=8 to 59). I over-weighted NSC and interpreted multinucleation as mitotic failure/cytokinesis failure (PMID 39639371), when actin cytoskeleton reorganization and epithelial sheet changes (PMID 20682174, PMID 37068870) better fit Epithelial. Actin contrast z=9-77 dominated but is shared across Epithelial, Actin disruptors and anti-mitotics. Lesson: atlas Protein synthesis neighbours reflect generic high-dose stress; low-dose 0.3 uM requested by PI (unacquired, budget 0) might have shown loss of polyploidy and revealed epithelial morphology at sub-toxic dose. Needed to keep Epithelial on board despite low prior.

reflection.text:
Unblinded truth is Epithelial (AZ-U, no PubChem CID/ChEMBL mechanism curated, e26), we scored 0. First submission Aurora kinase inhibitors p=0.46, second Protein synthesis p=0.32 after critique. Both wrong; hypothesis_history shows Epithelial held at 0.0 throughout with e15 cell_count rho=-1.00 as supposed contradictor. That was our core miss - we eliminated the true class a priori.

What the evidence did get right: there was a strong, dose-ordered cytoskeletal/nuclear phenotype. From e2 to e8: frac_large_nucleus z +8.7 at 1 uM (1036 cells) to +20.0 at 3 uM to +23.0 at 10 uM to +59.3 at 30 uM; act_glcm_contrast z +9.8 to +16.0 to +21.7 to +77.8; tub_mean z +5.9 to +9.7 to +11.9; tub_glcm_contrast z +43.8 at 30 uM. Dose_response e10-e14,e17,e23 all rho=+1.00 for frac_large_nucleus, act_glcm_contrast, tub_mean, tub_glcm_contrast, act_mean, frac_multinucleate_proxy and frac_mitotic_like, with cell_count rho=-1.00 e15 and nuc_area rho=-1.00 e22. This was correctly flagged as dose-dependent morphologic stress with actin texture change, nuclear size heterogeneity and reduced density. Actin remodeling is indeed a hallmark of epithelial plasticity in MCF-7, PMID 20682174 describes actin cytoskeleton participation in induction of invasive mesenchymal-like phenotype in MCF-7, and PMID 37068870 , PMID 33082491 , PMID 31747409 similarly link EMT/mechanical changes to actin/filamin reorganization. The signal was present but we labeled it as Actin disruptors (e6 3/10 neighbours, e9 3/10, e11 rho=+1.00) rather than as epithelial remodeling.

What misled us and why:

1. Over-weighting ambiguous visual heuristics vs atlas. e4 and e5 (4 and 2 fields) both returned candidates Aurora kinase inhibitors, Microtubule stabilizers with lower density vs DMSO, but explicitly noted indistinguishability from composites. We built first update e18 on those reads (Aurora 0.45 supporting e4,e5,e10,e13,e14) and discounted e6 NSC vote Actin disruptors 1/2 and k-neighbours Eg5 4/10, Actin 3/10. When we extended to 4 wells e9 NSC vote became Protein synthesis 3/4 with k-neighbours Protein synthesis 4/10, Actin 3/10, Eg5 2/10 and zero Aurora neighbours - the review critique was correct. We initially called NSC pointing to Protein synthesis noise and submitted 0.46 for Aurora, which was overconfident given single-replicate high-dose data and 30 uM terminal toxicity (114 cells e3 vs 1036 cells at 1 uM e2).

2. Misreading multinucleation/polyploidy as specific anti-mitotic. e10 frac_large_nucleus rho=+1.00, e13 frac_multinucleate_proxy rho=+1.00, e14 frac_mitotic_like rho=+1.00 fit textbook Aurora cytokinesis failure; PMID 39639371 shows TNK2 inhibitor causes polyploidization through mitotic failure by targeting Aurora B, illustrating why that pattern strongly suggests Aurora when seen in isolation. But the same readouts - large nucleus fraction, multinucleation proxy, actin contrast - also occur with actin-dependent cytokinesis failure, as the critique noted, and with epithelial-mesenchymal cytoskeletal reorganization PMID 20682174. Our contradictor set for Aurora (e6,e9) and for Actin/Protein synthesis (e14,e10) shows we treated the same rho=+1.00 trends as supporting one class and contradicting another without discriminative low-dose data.

3. Acquisition choice created non-discriminative dose-response. Per e1 we had 8 doses 0.01-30 uM but acquired only 1,3,10,30 uM single replicates (e2,e7,e8,e3). All dose_response calculations over those 4 wells are therefore monotonic by construction; rho=+1.00 for essentially every intensity/texture feature and rho=-1.00 for cell_count and nuc_area e15,e22 tells us about toxicity progression, not mechanism. Missing nuc_dna_mean was only rho=+0.80 p=0.2 e16 - weak DNA content increase argues against pure whole-genome doubling - but we did not weight it. The later microscopist reads e20 (4 fields, 7 obs, density lower, candidates unknown) and e21 (4 fields, 11 obs, density lower, candidates unknown) on the same intermediate wells we had already imaged showed the visual phenotype had become unclassifiable, contradicting the earlier Aurora vs Microtubule stabilizer call, yet we had no low-dose replicate to test persistence.

4. Failure to test the requested discriminative experiment. Review requested concentration_index 3 (0.3 uM) replicate 1 with atlas comparison: persistence of frac_large_nucleus/frac_mitotic_like at sub-toxic dose would support specific anti-mitotic, loss would favor atlas classes. Budget was 0/4 after 4 wells and we submitted second conclusion on existing data (Protein synthesis 0.32 supporting e9,e6,e7,e8, contradicting e10,e14,e20). That swing from Aurora 0.45 to Protein synthesis 0.32/Actin 0.26 demonstrates instability of inference on high-dose only data. We also never required an epithelial reference; we left Epithelial probability at 0.0 because we assumed e15 cell loss excluded it, without evidence that epithelial agents cannot reduce count in this assay.

Lessons for screening design: sample the full dynamic range including 0.01-0.3 uM with replicates before claiming Aurora/Eg5/microtubule vs actin vs epithelial; require at least 2-3 replicates to avoid single-well NSC votes driving conclusions; include explicit epithelial/EMT controls with quantitative phalloidin actin and tubulin spindle readouts plus DNA ploidy rather than relying on glcm_contrast and large-nucleus fraction alone, which are confounded across these classes at toxic doses.
what_was_right: Detected strong dose-ordered actin texture and nuclear heterogeneity: e2 act_glcm_contrast +9.8 frac_large_nucleus +8.7 at 1 uM to e3 +77.8 +59.3 at 30 uM, intermediate e7,e8 +16.0/+20.0 at 3 uM and +21.7/+23.0 at 10 uM

Flagged cytoskeletal reorganization relevant to epithelial biology: dose_response rho=+1.00 for act_glcm_contrast e11, act_mean e23, tub_mean e12, tub_glcm_contrast e17, consistent with literature on actin participation in MCF-7 epithelial plasticity PMID 20682174
Noted cell loss and nuclear area bimodality: e15 cell_count rho=-1.00, e22 nuc_area rho=-1.00, e3 114 cells terminal - correctly identified toxicity at high doses
what_was_wrong: First conclusion Aurora 0.46 contradicting e6/e9 atlas zero Aurora neighbours; second conclusion Protein synthesis 0.32 also wrong - truth Epithelial never rose above 0.0 in e18,e24

Interpreted rho=+1.00 for frac_large_nucleus e10, frac_multinucleate_proxy e13, frac_mitotic_like e14 as specific Aurora/anti-mitotic, while PMID 39639371 shows polyploidization via Aurora B is one of several routes to same phenotype and e20/e21 microscopist later called phenotype unknown
Used e15 cell_count drop to exclude Epithelial in hypothesis_history, without data that epithelial transition cannot reduce count/area in this MCF7 assay

## PI review

Verdict: request experiment.

Not approved — evidence does not separate leading hypotheses. Atlas over 4 wells votes Protein synthesis 3/4 with zero Aurora neighbours, while both phenotype reads state Aurora vs Microtubule stabilizers is indistinguishable from composites. Actin contrast is the largest deviation and actin disruption also explains multinucleation/cytokinesis failure. All wells are single-replicate, high-dose only (1-30 µM), with 30 µM terminal (114 cells). 0.46 for Aurora is therefore overconfident.

Requested: Acquire concentration_index 3 (0.3 µM), replicate 1, and run atlas comparison on it: persistence of frac_large_nucleus/frac_mitotic_like at sub-toxic dose would support a specific anti-mitotic/Aurora effect; loss of phenotype or continued Protein synthesis/Actin nearest-neighbour match would reject it in favour of the atlas classes.

## Verdict (computed by code)

Incorrect: agent said **Protein synthesis**, BBBC021 annotates **Epithelial**.

## Reflection

Unblinded truth is Epithelial (AZ-U, no PubChem CID/ChEMBL mechanism curated, e26), we scored 0. First submission Aurora kinase inhibitors p=0.46, second Protein synthesis p=0.32 after critique. Both wrong; hypothesis_history shows Epithelial held at 0.0 throughout with e15 cell_count rho=-1.00 as supposed contradictor. That was our core miss - we eliminated the true class a priori.

What the evidence did get right: there was a strong, dose-ordered cytoskeletal/nuclear phenotype. From e2 to e8: frac_large_nucleus z +8.7 at 1 uM (1036 cells) to +20.0 at 3 uM to +23.0 at 10 uM to +59.3 at 30 uM; act_glcm_contrast z +9.8 to +16.0 to +21.7 to +77.8; tub_mean z +5.9 to +9.7 to +11.9; tub_glcm_contrast z +43.8 at 30 uM. Dose_response e10-e14,e17,e23 all rho=+1.00 for frac_large_nucleus, act_glcm_contrast, tub_mean, tub_glcm_contrast, act_mean, frac_multinucleate_proxy and frac_mitotic_like, with cell_count rho=-1.00 e15 and nuc_area rho=-1.00 e22. This was correctly flagged as dose-dependent morphologic stress with actin texture change, nuclear size heterogeneity and reduced density. Actin remodeling is indeed a hallmark of epithelial plasticity in MCF-7, PMID 20682174 describes actin cytoskeleton participation in induction of invasive mesenchymal-like phenotype in MCF-7, and PMID 37068870 , PMID 33082491 , PMID 31747409 similarly link EMT/mechanical changes to actin/filamin reorganization. The signal was present but we labeled it as Actin disruptors (e6 3/10 neighbours, e9 3/10, e11 rho=+1.00) rather than as epithelial remodeling.

What misled us and why:

1. Over-weighting ambiguous visual heuristics vs atlas. e4 and e5 (4 and 2 fields) both returned candidates Aurora kinase inhibitors, Microtubule stabilizers with lower density vs DMSO, but explicitly noted indistinguishability from composites. We built first update e18 on those reads (Aurora 0.45 supporting e4,e5,e10,e13,e14) and discounted e6 NSC vote Actin disruptors 1/2 and k-neighbours Eg5 4/10, Actin 3/10. When we extended to 4 wells e9 NSC vote became Protein synthesis 3/4 with k-neighbours Protein synthesis 4/10, Actin 3/10, Eg5 2/10 and zero Aurora neighbours - the review critique was correct. We initially called NSC pointing to Protein synthesis noise and submitted 0.46 for Aurora, which was overconfident given single-replicate high-dose data and 30 uM terminal toxicity (114 cells e3 vs 1036 cells at 1 uM e2).

2. Misreading multinucleation/polyploidy as specific anti-mitotic. e10 frac_large_nucleus rho=+1.00, e13 frac_multinucleate_proxy rho=+1.00, e14 frac_mitotic_like rho=+1.00 fit textbook Aurora cytokinesis failure; PMID 39639371 shows TNK2 inhibitor causes polyploidization through mitotic failure by targeting Aurora B, illustrating why that pattern strongly suggests Aurora when seen in isolation. But the same readouts - large nucleus fraction, multinucleation proxy, actin contrast - also occur with actin-dependent cytokinesis failure, as the critique noted, and with epithelial-mesenchymal cytoskeletal reorganization PMID 20682174. Our contradictor set for Aurora (e6,e9) and for Actin/Protein synthesis (e14,e10) shows we treated the same rho=+1.00 trends as supporting one class and contradicting another without discriminative low-dose data.

3. Acquisition choice created non-discriminative dose-response. Per e1 we had 8 doses 0.01-30 uM but acquired only 1,3,10,30 uM single replicates (e2,e7,e8,e3). All dose_response calculations over those 4 wells are therefore monotonic by construction; rho=+1.00 for essentially every intensity/texture feature and rho=-1.00 for cell_count and nuc_area e15,e22 tells us about toxicity progression, not mechanism. Missing nuc_dna_mean was only rho=+0.80 p=0.2 e16 - weak DNA content increase argues against pure whole-genome doubling - but we did not weight it. The later microscopist reads e20 (4 fields, 7 obs, density lower, candidates unknown) and e21 (4 fields, 11 obs, density lower, candidates unknown) on the same intermediate wells we had already imaged showed the visual phenotype had become unclassifiable, contradicting the earlier Aurora vs Microtubule stabilizer call, yet we had no low-dose replicate to test persistence.

4. Failure to test the requested discriminative experiment. Review requested concentration_index 3 (0.3 uM) replicate 1 with atlas comparison: persistence of frac_large_nucleus/frac_mitotic_like at sub-toxic dose would support specific anti-mitotic, loss would favor atlas classes. Budget was 0/4 after 4 wells and we submitted second conclusion on existing data (Protein synthesis 0.32 supporting e9,e6,e7,e8, contradicting e10,e14,e20). That swing from Aurora 0.45 to Protein synthesis 0.32/Actin 0.26 demonstrates instability of inference on high-dose only data. We also never required an epithelial reference; we left Epithelial probability at 0.0 because we assumed e15 cell loss excluded it, without evidence that epithelial agents cannot reduce count in this assay.

Lessons for screening design: sample the full dynamic range including 0.01-0.3 uM with replicates before claiming Aurora/Eg5/microtubule vs actin vs epithelial; require at least 2-3 replicates to avoid single-well NSC votes driving conclusions; include explicit epithelial/EMT controls with quantitative phalloidin actin and tubulin spindle readouts plus DNA ploidy rather than relying on glcm_contrast and large-nucleus fraction alone, which are confounded across these classes at toxic doses.

What was right:
- Detected strong dose-ordered actin texture and nuclear heterogeneity: e2 act_glcm_contrast +9.8 frac_large_nucleus +8.7 at 1 uM to e3 +77.8 +59.3 at 30 uM, intermediate e7,e8 +16.0/+20.0 at 3 uM and +21.7/+23.0 at 10 uM
- Flagged cytoskeletal reorganization relevant to epithelial biology: dose_response rho=+1.00 for act_glcm_contrast e11, act_mean e23, tub_mean e12, tub_glcm_contrast e17, consistent with literature on actin participation in MCF-7 epithelial plasticity PMID 20682174
- Noted cell loss and nuclear area bimodality: e15 cell_count rho=-1.00, e22 nuc_area rho=-1.00, e3 114 cells terminal - correctly identified toxicity at high doses

What was wrong or missed:
- First conclusion Aurora 0.46 contradicting e6/e9 atlas zero Aurora neighbours; second conclusion Protein synthesis 0.32 also wrong - truth Epithelial never rose above 0.0 in e18,e24
- Interpreted rho=+1.00 for frac_large_nucleus e10, frac_multinucleate_proxy e13, frac_mitotic_like e14 as specific Aurora/anti-mitotic, while PMID 39639371 shows polyploidization via Aurora B is one of several routes to same phenotype and e20/e21 microscopist later called phenotype unknown
- Used e15 cell_count drop to exclude Epithelial in hypothesis_history, without data that epithelial transition cannot reduce count/area in this MCF7 assay

Proposed next experiment: Acquire 0.03, 0.1, 0.3 uM replicates 1-3 plus DMSO and recompute NSC/kNN on full range; run multiplex high-resolution imaging for p-H3 Ser10, alpha-tubulin spindle morphology, phalloidin actin quantitative texture and DNA ploidy flow vs reference Aurora, Eg5, microtubule stabilizer, actin disruptor, protein synthesis inhibitor and epithelial/EMT controls to separate sub-toxic specific mitotic failure from high-dose actin/epithelial remodeling
